name: il
description: A hook-enforced development harness for Codex: spec approval gates that actually block, 30-second session resume, and verification that never saw the implementation.

interface.shortDescription: Spec gates that actually block, and a 30-second resume
interface.longDescription: Interlocking blocks source edits until a human has approved the spec, restores an interrupted session from a written anchor, and judges the result with a verifier that never saw the implementation. The gate is a PreToolUse hook, so it refuses the tool call rather than asking the model to behave. Approval is recorded from literal keystrokes on UserPromptSubmit, which is what keeps the model out of it.
defaultPrompt: Spec out a new feature under interlocking
